gen-gf-over-the-rainbow-fs-technor: Casual and a little scrawled, Over the Rainbow reads like bent steel rod. Technor, a plain sans of glowing neon-tube lines, feels cool and geometric, and is better kept to brief copy than long pages.
gen-gf-overlock-fs-paquito: Overlock's s curves flare open at both ends, with stems nearly touching. What stands out most is confidence: Paquito, a text serif that leaves barely any gap between lowercase and caps, handles a line or two with ease.
gen-gf-overlock-sc-fs-karma: Distinctive and commanding, Overlock SC keeps its capitals close in height to lowercase, with broad open counters on c and s. Karma steps in with softer, moderate contrast beneath that low-contrast heading.
gen-gf-overlock-sc-fs-paquito: Capitals and lowercase sit nearly level in Overlock SC, its broad counters opening on c and s. But Overlock SC does the announcing, while Paquito gives a few lines a confident, approachable voice.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: BhuTuka Expanded One is literary and curvy, with thin joins as stout as its stems, set under Oxanium's tall, monoline heading. BhuTuka Expanded One slows any extended reading to a leisurely walk, unhurried and authoritative.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-hepta-slab: Dignified and bookish, Hepta Slab sits under Oxanium's big lowercase. Its stretched-out words and open counters breathe into the white space, while the heading's monoline strokes stay crisp and uninterrupted.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-kiwi-maru: Sharp and spacious: Oxanium's tall lowercase and monoline strokes meet Kiwi Maru's round, generous letterspace. But Oxanium does the commanding, while Kiwi Maru does the quiet, traditional work of carrying the words.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Oxanium brings a tall, monoline lowercase with curves that end in clear daylight. Padyakke Expanded One is the real draw, wide and literary, its glyphs strung like knots on a slack rope.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Authoritative and traditional, Stint Ultra Expanded lets each character float apart beneath Oxanium's commanding heading. And since its serif letters are so spread out, Stint Ultra Expanded can sit at a modest size.
gen-gf-pangolin-fs-familjen-grotesk: Loose, hand-drawn charm up top: Pangolin's one-nib letters are easygoing, generous and tall, with wide c apertures. Familjen Grotesk, a plain sans with open-sided bowls, keeps brief copy lively.
